'''"Siren"''' is an Overseer of the [[Fractsidus]] who is first mentioned during [[All That Sunlight Touches]]. Their identity remains unknown and "Siren" is a codename, although [[Luuk Herssen]] was able to discover that they often work in tandem with fellow Overseer [["Hydra"]].

==Trivia==
===Etymology===
*{{W|Siren (mythology)|Sirens}} {{Lang|grc=Σειρῆνες}} are humanlike, and more commonly female, beings that use their alluring voices to lure sailors to their deaths in {{W|Greek mythology}}.
